identity.name: Syed Nafiz Reja Hasib
identity.headline: Civil Engineer · Computational Design and Mechanics
identity.summary: I work on computational design and mechanics of structures: finite-element analysis, form-finding and optimisation, with seismic safety and embodied carbon as design variables. Concrete shells are my current test case.
